Returns the default PrometheusOptions with metrics served from /metrics, method labels included, path normalization enabled, and the default route cardinality limit.Creates a new PrometheusRegistry with an empty route table and zeroed counters, clamping the maximum tracked route count to at least 16.Takes a snapshot of all route metrics under the registry lock and renders them as a Prometheus text exposition string with request counters, a duration histogram, and the in-flight gauge.

Prometheus metrics middleware: records per-route request counters, status group counts, and latency histograms, and serves them in Prometheus text format at options.metricsPath.

Requests to the metrics path itself are short-circuited and are NOT recorded in the collected metrics (matches Prometheus client library conventions, e.g. Go's promhttp.Handler); the in-flight gauge therefore does not include scrapes in progress.

The exposition endpoint has no access control by design. Enforce access control at the infrastructure level (dedicated metrics port, reverse proxy allow/deny, VPN) rather than in application middleware.

Creates the Prometheus metrics middleware with default options but a custom metrics path.
